description: List pickup orders as the pickup monitor board shows them: stage (New, Printed, Picked, Ready, On Hold, Completed), customer and contact, pickup code, scheduled pickup time in store-local time, pickup position, unread customer replies and the ready notification's outcome. view: new (default, the open board), active, ready, hidden (on hold), all, today (picked up today), future or pickedUp. includeCompleted adds orders completed in the last 30 days. Without store, covers every store you can see. Use get_pickup_order for lines and the message log, and move_pickup_order to move one.

includeCompleted.description: Include orders completed in the last 30 days.

includeHidden.description: Include on-hold orders in the other views.

search.description: Case-insensitive text to find in the number, customer or pickup code.

store.description: Store id, code or name; omit for every store you can see.

view.description: new (default), active, ready, hidden, all, today, future or pickedUp.

name: list_pickup_orders
title: List Pickup Orders
